chunks.head: find fault with
chunks.note: find fault with sb/sth = 对…吹毛求疵、找茬。

literal.note_cn: 此处指挑出毛病,非'找到(好东西)'

chunks.ex_en: Don't always find fault with your little brother.
chunks.ex_cn: 别总是挑你弟弟的毛病。

chunks.head: leak out
chunks.note: leak out = 秘密/消息不知不觉走漏出去。

literal.note_cn: 此处指秘密走漏,非'漏水'

chunks.ex_en: The secret plan leaked out before the party.
chunks.ex_cn: 那个秘密计划在派对前走漏了。

chunks.head: get through
chunks.note: get through (sth) = 把某事从头做到尾、完成;此处指侦探把事办完。
chunks.ex_en: Let's get through the homework before dinner.
chunks.ex_cn: 我们晚饭前把作业做完吧。

chunks.head: leave behind
chunks.note: leave sth behind = 把东西留在原处或丢下。
chunks.ex_en: They left behind a lot of trash after the picnic.
chunks.ex_cn: 野餐后他们留下了一堆垃圾。

chunks.head: to one's credit
chunks.note: to one's credit = 这一点值得称道;one's 处填人/事的所有格。
chunks.ex_en: To her credit, she never gave up.
chunks.ex_cn: 值得称赞的是,她从不放弃。

chunks.head: after nightfall
chunks.ex_en: It gets very cold here after nightfall.
chunks.ex_cn: 这里天黑之后会变得很冷。
